newsitem.title: USA: Star Banc sees Q3 $0.11/shr chrg from SAIF.
newsitem.headline: Star Banc sees Q3 $0.11/shr chrg from SAIF.

text.p: Star Banc Corp, parent of Star Bank NA, said Wednesday it expects to pay a one-time premium of $5 million for the Savings Association Insurance Fund, reducing third quarter earnings by about $0.11 per share.
The $9.6 billion multi-bank holding company said the actual assessment will be lower than the $6-11 million previously expected by its management.
Newly ennacted SAIF legislation requires banks with SAIF to make a one-time payment to replenish the SAIF Fund and contains a provision cutting deposit premiums on SAIF-insured deposits.
Star Banc said it expects to cut an estimated $1.8 million in its deposit insurance in 1997 through 2000.
Star Banc said it should announce third quarter earnings on October 10.
